info.title: xd-icon
info.description: Makes the icons of an app from one svg or png: .ico (Windows), .icns (macOS), png (Linux) and the MauiIcon files, with optional variants drawn for the small sizes.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Makes the icons of an app from one drawing. Variants for the small sizes sit next to it, named after it:
app.24.svg draws the sizes up to 24 px, app.40.svg those up to 40, app.svg the others.

options.name: --out
options.description: where to write (default: the folder of the icon)

options.name: --maui
options.description: appicon.svg (the background color) and appiconfg.svg for a MauiIcon
